title: IMMA boundaries (IUCN MMPATF)
description: Official boundaries of the IMMAs that include the Guiana dolphin within its range, simplified for display (about 500 m tolerance). Source: IUCN MMPATF (2025) Global Dataset of Important Marine Mammal Areas (IUCN-IMMA), made available under agreement on terms and conditions of use by the IUCN Joint SSC/WCPA Marine Mammal Protected Areas Task Force, https://www.marinemammalhabitat.org/imma-eatlas/
